                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/WangNoNo/p/19423598" title="发布于 2025-12-30 23:05">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">P5607 [Ynoi2013] 无力回天 NOI2017 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>一道很好的题，如果做法不当（像我）可能需要一些卡常。</p>
<h2 id="part-1-bitset-20tps">Part 1. bitset 20tps</h2>
<p>插入？并集？ <span class="math inline">\(1e5\)</span> ？显然可以用 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 维护：</p>
<ul>
<li>每次修改把第 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 中的第 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 位修改成1</li>
<li>每次查询将 <span class="math inline">\(x1\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(x2\)</span> 两个 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 取或求1的个数即可</li>
</ul>
<p>这样可以轻松获得20tps。</p>
<h3 id="code">Code</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int N = 1e5 + 5;

int m;
bitset&lt;N&gt; b[N];
void solve(){
	cin &gt;&gt; m;
	while(m--){
		ll opt, x, y; cin &gt;&gt; opt &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
		if(opt == 1){
			b[x][y] = 1;
		}else{
			cout &lt;&lt; (b[x] | b[y]).count() &lt;&lt; "\n";
		}
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="part-2-哈希表-34tps">Part 2. 哈希表 34tps</h2>
<p>考虑其实只需要维护两两之间的答案，最多 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 组</p>
<ul>
<li>每次修改把所有修改过 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 的和当前的集合间的交集大小加1，并记录每个集合的大小</li>
<li>每次查询将两个集合相加减去并集即可</li>
</ul>
<p>这样可以轻松获得34tps。（注：pb_ds哈希表使用方法在最后）</p>
<h3 id="code-1">Code</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int N = 1e6 + 5;

int m, maxn, siz[N];
cc_hash_table&lt;int, int&gt; ans[N];
vector&lt;int&gt; vc[N];

void solve(){
	cin &gt;&gt; m;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++){
        int opt, x, y; cin &gt;&gt; opt &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
        if(opt == 1){
        	++siz[x];
        	int x0, x1;
            for(int num : vc[y]){
            	x0 = x, x1 = num;
				if(x0 &gt; x1) swap(x0, x1);
				++ans[x0][x1];
			}
            vc[y].pb(x);
        }
        else{
            if(x == y){
            	cout &lt;&lt; siz[x] &lt;&lt; "\n";
            	continue;
			}
            if(x &gt; y) swap(x, y);
			int ans1 = ans[x][y];
			cout &lt;&lt; siz[x] + siz[y] - ans1&lt;&lt; "\n";
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="part-3-正解-100tps">Part 3. 正解 100tps</h2>
<p>我们思考，</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 的优势在于高效处理多次出现，缺点是空间开不下</li>
<li>哈希表的优势在于空间小，缺点是多次出现时会TLE</li>
</ul>
<p>怎么办呢？考虑结合以上两种做法，对于多次出现交给 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 处理，其他数据由空间小的哈希表处理。</p>
<p>具体的，考虑进行根号分治，设临界值为 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> ，记 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的出现次数为 <span class="math inline">\(cnt_x\)</span> ，对于每个数 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>：</p>
<ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(cnt_x&lt;B\)</span> ，用哈希表处理</li>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(cnt_x&gt;B\)</span> ，用 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 处理</li>
</ul>
<p>考虑到 <span class="math inline">\(bitset\)</span> 的复杂度，当 <span class="math inline">\(B=\sqrt{m/w}\)</span>时达到理论最优值</p>
<p>直接写完你就会发现MLE，怎么办？只需要改成<s>出生</s>可可爱爱の指针就可以了！</p>
<h3 id="code-2">Code</h3>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">const int N = 1e6 + 5, B = 8192, B1 = N / B;

int m, maxn, siz[N];
struct node{
    int opt, x, y;
} q[N];
bitset&lt;B&gt; *b[N];
cc_hash_table&lt;int, int&gt; *ans[N];
vector&lt;int&gt; vc[N];
int cnt[N], f[N], tot;

void init(){
	cin &gt;&gt; m;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++){
        cin &gt;&gt; q[i].opt &gt;&gt; q[i].x &gt;&gt; q[i].y;
        if(q[i].opt == 1) ++cnt[q[i].y];
        else if(q[i].x &gt; q[i].y) swap(q[i].x, q[i].y);
    }
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) if(cnt[i] &gt; B1) f[i] = ++tot; maxn = tot;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) if(cnt[i] &lt;= B1) f[i] = ++tot;
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) if(q[i].opt == 1) q[i].y = f[q[i].y];
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++) if(q[i].opt == 2){
    	if(!ans[q[i].x]) ans[q[i].x] = new cc_hash_table&lt;int, int&gt;();
        (*ans[q[i].x])[q[i].y] = 0;
	}
}
void solve(){
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= m; i++){
        if(q[i].opt == 1){
        	++siz[q[i].x];
            if(q[i].y &lt;= maxn){
            	if(!b[q[i].x]) b[q[i].x] = new bitset&lt;B&gt;();
            	(*b[q[i].x])[q[i].y] = 1;
			}
            else{
            	int x0, x1;
            	if(vc[q[i].y].size() != 0){
	                for(int num : vc[q[i].y]){
	                	x0 = q[i].x, x1 = num;
						if(x0 &gt; x1) swap(x0, x1);
						if(!ans[x0]) continue;
						if(ans[x0] -&gt; find(x1) != ans[x0] -&gt; end()) ++(*ans[x0])[x1];
	                }
				}
                vc[q[i].y].pb(q[i].x);
            }
        }else{
            if(q[i].x == q[i].y){
            	cout &lt;&lt; siz[q[i].x] &lt;&lt; "\n";
            	continue;
			}
			int ans1 = (*ans[q[i].x])[q[i].y], ans2 = 0;
			if(b[q[i].x] &amp;&amp; b[q[i].y]) ans2 = (*b[q[i].x] &amp; *b[q[i].y]).count();
			cout &lt;&lt; siz[q[i].x] + siz[q[i].y] - ans1 - ans2 &lt;&lt; "\n";
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="part-4-补充">Part 4. 补充</h2>
<p>pb_ds使用须知：</p>
<p>请使用以下头文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/priority_queue.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/exception.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/hash_policy.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/list_update_policy.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp&gt;
#include&lt;ext/pb_ds/trie_policy.hpp&gt;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
</code></pre>
